draft.description: Check a PO's delivery schedule, its latest certificate and open NCRs for that vendor

draft.name: Check PO Delivery and Vendor NCRs
draft.instruction: 1. Search emails, chats, and Drive for the delivery schedule related to {PO number}. 2. Read the latest material test certificate for {PO number}. 3. Search past non-conformance reports (NCRs) for {vendor name}. 4. Present the delivery schedule, certificate status, and open NCRs concisely with citations.

draft.description: Before an inspection, check which certificate values for a heat number are out of spec

draft.name: Check Heat Certificate Spec
draft.instruction: 1. Search for the material test certificate matching {heat number}. 2. Read the certificate values and compare them against the standards library using Spec Check. 3. List any out-of-spec values found. Present the result clearly with short citations.

draft.description: Tell me the latest revision of a drawing, who approved it and what changed

draft.name: Check Drawing Revision History
draft.instruction: 1. Search files and the drawing revision register for {Drawing number}. 2. Identify the latest revision number and date. 3. Read the drawing revision register entry to find who approved the latest revision and the description of what changed. 4. Present the results concisely with citations to the drawing and register.

draft.description: Every Monday: which vendors are late on their promises and what they owe me

draft.name: Weekly Vendor Promise Review
draft.instruction: 1. Search my emails, chats, and files for vendor promise records due up to today. 2. Compare the due dates and promised deliverables with the actual status of materials or components. 3. List each vendor who is late on their promise and detail what items they currently owe me. 4. Present the result clearly with sources and short citations.

draft.description: har Monday dekho kaun se vendor late hain aur unke promises kya the

draft.name: Somwar Ki Vendor Late List
draft.instruction: 1. Check the vendor and colleague promise records for the last week to identify which vendors are late. 2. Search past chats, emails, and files for any updates or new commitments from those late vendors. 3. Look up plant data and shift handovers to see the impact of these delays on production. 4. Present the results as a short, cited summary of late vendors and their broken promises.

draft.description: Kisi machine ka downtime history aur pichhle fixes batao

draft.name: Machine Downtime History Checker
draft.instruction: 1. Search chat, files, and email for downtime records related to {Machine Name}. 2. Look up past NCRs and downtime logs with their fixes for {Machine Name}. 3. Present the result concisely with citations.

draft.description: Prep me for my next meeting: who is attending, open tasks with them and recent decisions

draft.name: Meeting Preparation Assistant
draft.instruction: 1. Search calendar to find the next upcoming meeting and list its attendees. 2. Search chats, emails, and files for any open tasks assigned to or shared with the attendees. 3. Search the decision log for recent decisions involving the attendees. 4. Present the result as a short, cited summary.

draft.description: Find the decisions taken about a part and why they were taken

draft.name: Find Part Decision History
draft.instruction: 1. Search the decision log for all entries related to {Part Name}. 2. Cross-reference past NCRs and downtime logs for {Part Name} to identify related issues. 3. Summarize the decisions taken and their recorded rationales. 4. Present the result concisely with citations to the log entries.

draft.description: For a vendor, compare promised and actual dispatch dates this month

draft.name: Vendor Dispatch Date Audit
draft.instruction: 1. Search emails, chats, and vendor promise records for {vendor name} regarding dispatch dates scheduled for {month}. 2. Compare the promised dispatch dates with the actual dispatch logs and plant data. 3. Identify any discrepancies or delays between promised and actual dates. 4. Present a short, cited summary of the comparison results.

draft.description: Draft a reminder task to follow up with the vendor on a PO tomorrow morning

draft.name: Vendor PO Follow-up Reminder
draft.instruction: 1. Search chats, email, and Drive for the given {PO number} and {vendor name}. 2. Check the vendor promise records for delivery timelines. 3. Look up past non-conformance reports or delays associated with this {vendor name}. 4. Draft a reminder task for tomorrow morning to follow up with the vendor regarding the {PO number}. Present the result as a short, cited summary of the drafted task.

draft.name: Check PO Delivery and Certificates
draft.instruction: 1. Search chats, files, and emails for delivery updates and status for {PO number}. 2. Locate material test certificates associated with {PO number}. 3. Run a Spec Check on the certificates against the standards library. 4. Check vendor promise records for {PO number} commitments. 5. Present a short, cited summary of the delivery status, certificate verdict, and vendor commitments.

draft.description: Heat K-55210 ka certificate S355J2 ke limits ke against check karo

draft.name: Heat Certificate Check
draft.instruction: 1. Search for the material test certificate for {heat number}. 2. Read the certificate and run a Spec Check verdict against the standards library for {grade}. 3. Present the result concisely with citations.
